key_insights: Recommends researching the specific college's values/culture/traditions in depth beforehand so genuine enthusiasm comes through naturally in conversation

Advises preparing (but not scripting) answers to common questions like 'why this college,' 'a time you faced a challenge,' and 'tell me about yourself'
Stresses asking the interviewer genuine questions too, since it's a two-way conversation and interviewers are often alumni with useful insight
When discussing weaknesses/challenges, advises spending more time on growth and resolution than dwelling on the difficulty itself
